LESSON: NUMBER RECOGNITION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Numbers
Topic 2.2: Number Recognition
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Number Recognition, part of Numbers in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we use numbers in day-to- day lifes?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Observe and read number symbols on number flash cards or number charts. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative modes of communication to give their responses.

2. Work with other in identifying number symbols on flashcard or charts.

3. Cooperate with peers to identify number symbols found on different objects in the school compound. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to identify number symbols in the school compound.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Observe and read number symbols on number flash cards or number charts. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative modes of communication to give their responses.
2. Work with other in identifying number symbols on flashcard or charts.
3. Cooperate with peers to identify number symbols found on different objects in the school compound. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to identify number symbols in the school compound.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Number Recognition together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: learners use digital devices to identify and type number symbols.

Values:
Unity: learners amicably work with others to arrange numbers flash cards for numbers 1-20.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-esteem: learners’ self-esteem is enhanced as they play number recognition games.

Link to Other Activity Areas:

The learner is able to relate reading of numbers on flash cards with reading other symbols in Language Activities.
